::: {.hidden}
{{< include /samples/single-source/personal/_guestbook.qmd >}}

:::

I designed and built a mobile-responsive Next.js application styled with Tailwind CSS and a backend powered by Supabase, featuring:

- Admin functionality for comment management and customization, dashboard gated via Google OAuth 2.0.
- Built-in rate limiting and profanity filtering, and admin notifications powered by Supabase Edge Functions.
- Docs in MDX with Gemini chatbot, API reference implemented with Scalar. 

## Concept

Nostalgic for the days of Geocities, anonymous guestbooks, and Adobe Flash animation websites, I built a modernized version with a poetic twist:


::: {.iframe url="https://beck-chan.vercel.app/" title="My Modernized Guestbook" zoom="50%"}
:::

Alongside the interactive API library, I built a chatbot powered by Gemini that can answer questions about the documentation:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Live Chatbot

The live chatbot uses Supabase's `pgvector` extension to store the embeddings of the documentation, and the Gemini API to answer questions:

![Live Chatbot Powered by `pgvector`](livebot.gif){.pics width="100%"}

### Proof-of-Concept Chatbot

My initial, more complex proof-of-concept chatbot used a local Elasticsearch instance served via Docker and the Gemini API to answer questions about the documentation:
